yyene17a.sourceDescription: This contemporary artificial Christmas tree offers an elegant festive touch to any space. Blending modern design with holiday tradition, it serves as an ideal centerpiece for both indoor and outdoor festivities, emanating a welcoming glow. Sleek Modern Design Highlighting clean lines and minimal ornamentation, this tree resonates with modern aesthetics. Its streamlined silhouette complements contemporary home decor beautifully, creating a stylish yet timeless festive atmosphere. Convenient USB Connectivity: Equipped with a USB connector, this tree allows for versatile power options, ensuring effortless setup without the need for traditional outlets. This ensures flexibility for positioning anywhere at home or outside. Warm White LED Lights: This tree illuminates your space with charming, energy-efficient LED lighting. The soft, warm white glow creates an inviting ambiance, enhancing holiday gatherings whether tucked in a cozy living room or gracing a scenic terrace. Durable PVC &Steel Build: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree showcases lasting resilience while remaining light enough for easy portability. Supporting the tree, a steel frame provides stability, ensuring it withstands seasonal celebrations year after year. Simple Assembly and Maintenance: This product features a streamlined setup requiring just a screwdriver, making quick work of assembly. To maintain its appearance, cover the tree when not in use, protecting it during inclement weather or off-seasons. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

t52nz2z9.sourceDescription: Wish your garden had a Christmas wow-factor? The Outsunny Christmas inflatable turns your outdoor space into a festive wonderland. Standing 150 cm tall, this velvet-look Santa features a cosy red suit, white beard and welcoming gesture. Built-in LED lights create a warm glow, adding holiday charm to your garden and celebrations. ● Christmas inflatable decoration stands 150 cm tall in a charming velvet look Santa Claus design with a welcoming gesture ● Bright integrated LED light effects enhance nighttime visibility to maximise outdoor festive atmosphere ● Integrated blower system and a bottom zipper enable rapid inflation in about 1 minute ● Safe low-voltage and standard UK BS plug for reliable operation. Long power cord for flexible placement ● Waterproof 210T polyester fabric features reinforced airtight seams for outdoor durability ● Includes 4 ground stakes, 2 tether ropes, 2 sandbags and a 100cm hanging rope for versatile installation ● Includes a storage bag for convenient organization ● A wonderful holiday gift for friends and family, suitable for gardens, lawns and party spaces ● Colour: White, Red ● Type: Inflatable Christmas Velvet Look Santa Claus ● Material: 210T Polyester Cloth ● Overall Dimensions: 94L x 56W x 150H cm ● Power Cable Length: 1.9 m ● Sandbag Weight: 0.4 kg ● LED Light Count: 1 ● LED Light Power: 0.5W ● Fan: 12V / 0.8A ● Input Voltage: 220-240V, 50/60Hz ● Output Voltage: 12V / 1A ● Item Label: 84J-330V70RD ● NOTE: Keep plug in while in use and unplugging after eight hours to help prolong the life of the motor Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
